text: We currently deliver orders within Abu Dhabi only.
Standard delivery inside Abu Dhabi city takes 1 to 2 business days.
Same-day delivery may be available in selected Abu Dhabi areas when the order is placed before 12 PM.
Delivery is available to Abu Dhabi city, Khalifa City, Mohammed Bin Zayed City, Al Reem Island, Al Raha, and Yas Island.
We do not currently deliver to Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, or other emirates.
Customers must provide a complete Abu Dhabi address, building name, apartment or villa number, and contact number for delivery.
Delivery fees inside Abu Dhabi are calculated during checkout based on the delivery area.
If the customer is unavailable during delivery, our courier will contact them to reschedule within Abu Dhabi.
Orders can be returned within 7 days of delivery if the item is unused, unopened, and in its original packaging.
Electronics can only be returned if all accessories, manuals, warranty cards, and original packaging are included.
Opened electronics are not eligible for return unless they are defective or damaged on arrival.
Refunds are processed after the returned item passes inspection by our support team.
Return pickup is available within Abu Dhabi only.
Customers must report damaged or incorrect items within 24 hours of delivery.
Most electronics include a 1-year manufacturer warranty unless a different warranty period is mentioned on the product page.
The electronics warranty covers manufacturing defects but does not cover physical damage, liquid damage, misuse, or unauthorized repair.
Warranty claims for electronics require the original invoice and the product serial number.
Accessories such as chargers, cables, and batteries may have a shorter warranty period depending on the manufacturer.
For electronics warranty service, customers can contact support to arrange inspection or service center guidance in Abu Dhabi.
Customer support is available for Abu Dhabi delivery, returns, and electronics warranty questions at help@company.com.
